subject.scope: public unauthenticated desktop and mobile web with bounded authenticated-journey hypotheses

confirmed_findings.claim: A public chart route returns the generic Tradernet 404 experience for mobile user-agents.
confirmed_findings.product_impact: A mobile user loses access to a public analytical capability and receives no useful supported-state explanation.
confirmed_findings.repair: Preserve instrument context and serve a supported mobile chart or explicit supported-state route.

confirmed_findings.claim: Late discovery of the selected mobile hero image materially delays largest contentful paint.
confirmed_findings.product_impact: Meaningful content appears several avoidable seconds late, increasing abandonment and uncertainty.
confirmed_findings.repair: Expose the selected responsive LCP resource in initial HTML and prioritise only that resource.

confirmed_findings.claim: Mobile terminal entry downloads a 346800-byte image that renders at 0x0.
confirmed_findings.product_impact: The user pays network, battery and time cost for an invisible resource.
confirmed_findings.repair: Prevent the hidden responsive branch from requesting the asset.

confirmed_findings.claim: Terminal entry requests a missing first-party onboarding asset.
confirmed_findings.product_impact: The product creates redundant request and diagnostic noise; no visible break is claimed.
confirmed_findings.repair: Remove or correct the obsolete first-party asset reference.

product_hypotheses.claim: Real/demo, market session, data freshness, account currency, margin state and buying power should remain visible on every trading surface.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Run a desktop/mobile state matrix against an authorised test account.

product_hypotheses.claim: The order confirmation should expose instrument, direction, quantity, type, estimated behaviour, fee, conversion, total, session consequence and post-action state.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Capture market, limit, insufficient-funds and closed-session flows on an authorised test account.

product_hypotheses.claim: A buy limit above ask or sell limit below bid should explain likely immediate execution within the limit.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Run bid/ask-bounded order-preview cases without submitting a real order unless separately authorised.

product_hypotheses.claim: Order cancellation should use an explicit label and show requested, confirmed or execution-won-the-race states.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Record cancellation state transitions in a safe authorised environment.

product_hypotheses.claim: Stop Loss and Take Profit should be discoverable from the selected position with a financial risk preview.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Measure task success, path length and comprehension on desktop and mobile web.

product_hypotheses.claim: Positions and orders should transform into task cards rather than compressed horizontally scrolling tables.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Compare successful management tasks, mis-taps, scroll distance and completion time.

product_hypotheses.claim: Interrupted drafts should restore input but invalidate stale previews and require a fresh review.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Interrupt, resume and reconnect order drafts while tracing quote and session freshness.

product_hypotheses.claim: Public entry should distinguish start investing, active trading and demo exploration.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Run a controlled entry-page experiment with qualified activation as the primary metric.

product_hypotheses.claim: Cold traffic should be able to realise low-risk value through a watchlist and simulated order preview before funding.
product_hypotheses.next_test: Compare demo activation, qualified signup, KYC completion and seven-day return.

primary_metric.name: qualified_seven_day_activation
primary_metric.definition: Share of eligible new users who complete required identity steps, realise the first value for their selected intent, and complete one intentional product action without a preventable correction or support incident.

verdict_meaning: Confirmed public findings may be prepared for human reporting. Authenticated journey recommendations remain hypotheses until exact-build authorised evidence exists.
